answer: No worker files their own claim. A claim reaches the desk only when the buyer sends it down the River from the Haven where verified buyers gather, and the Ridge clerk checks the buyer's standing within a day before the claim is even read. A claim filed by the worker, or sent by a buyer with no history in the Haven, is rejected and forfeits a 200-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 real buyers with real histories plus 200,000 coins in bonds. One operator invented forty buyers, none had ever bought anything in the Haven, and every claim died at the Ridge.
